items.title: Stonewall Democrats Statement Thanking President Biden for His LGBTQ Record
items.body: July 21, 2024 - Today, the Stonewall Democrats of NYC thank President Biden for his decades of leadership on LGBTQ issues, and commend his selfless decision not to seek a second term. President Biden has led with compassion, moral clarity and incredible effectiveness as the Biden-Harris Administration has passed landmark advances for LGBTQ people, from protecting trans rights, codifying marriage equality, and more. SDNYC will honor President Biden’s model of dedication to the America people and commit to ensuring that Democrats win in November, and the work to achieve LGBTQ equality will continue to move forward.

items.title: March in NYC Pride with SDNYC & Out for Biden-Harris
items.body:
President Joe Biden and Vice-President Kamala Harris have led the most pro-LGBTQ administration in history. With so much on the line, Stonewall Democrats of NYC is thrilled to be joined by Out for Biden-Harris for the NYC Pride March, where we will celebrate the advances in LGBTQ+ rights under President Biden, and make sure our community is engaged and dedicated to re-electing him in the fall! 

Details
Date: Sunday, June 30th
Line Up Time: TBD - likely 9-10am
Line Up Location: TBD - likely near 5th Ave and 30th St
Contact: stonewalldemocraticclubnyc@gmail.com

We will share details on the meet up time and location close to the day of the March! RSVP to receive the information. Thank you! We look forward to seeing you there!

items.title: The time has come... for you to vote...For...Your...Rights!
items.body:
It may be the final week of Pride Month, but the impact of electing pro-LGBTQ candidates at every level of government will impact the future of our community for years to come. So make sure you vote in the NY Primary by Tuesday, June 25th. This is our chance to ensure that we select the strongest Democratic candidates for the General Election who will champion LGBTQ+ issues. Make sure you vote today, Sunday, or Tuesday! 

NY State Primary Details

Early Voting - Saturday, June 15th, 2024 to Sunday, June 23rd
Election Day - Tuesday, June 25, 2024. Polls are open from 6am to 9pm

Early Voting Time and Locations: https://www.vote.nyc/elections 
Find your Poll Site here: https://vote.nyc/page/find-your-poll-site

Candidates and our members engaged in an endorsement process to ensure that our endorsed candidates are aligned to our issues. You can read candidate questionnaires here.

items.title: Love Will Save The Day - SDNYC's 2024 Annual Event
items.body:
Thank you to all our friends, members, and guests who joined for our 2024 Pride Event on June 12th, 2024! It was wonderful to see so many leaders, elected officials, and luminaries celebrate together and celebrate our progress. Our honorees - Assembly Member Danny O’Donnell, Tanya Walker, Carol Bullock, Justin Sanchez, State Senator Sarah McBride, and Duncan Crabtree-Ireland - gave us hope for the challenges ahead and fired us up to continue fighting for the LGBTQ community in NYC and beyond!

All photos credit: Donna Aceto Photography

items.title: JOIN US 6/12 FOR OUR ANNUAL EVENT: LOVE WILL SAVE THE DAY
items.body:
SDNYC is thrilled to invite you to Love Will Save The Day, our Annual Pride Event, on Wednesday, June 12, 2024, from 6:30-9:30pm at God’s Love We Deliver, in SoHo. (166 6th Ave, New York, NY 10013) Tickets available here

We are proud to be recognizing the work of incredible leaders who have achieved momentous breakthroughs for the LGBTQ community: 

  • Hon. Danny O'Donnell - Trailblazing NYS Assembly Member & lead sponsor of many of the most important LGBTQ bills of the past 20 years

  • Tanya Walker - Equality New York organizer, and legendary trans activist, including leading the fight for GENDA and suing the Trump Administration

  • Carol Bullock - Exec Director of the Staten Island Pride Center, which finally won the battle for an LGBTQ inclusive St Pats Parade this year

  • Justin Sanchez - President Emeritus of SDNYC and rising star in the Bronx 

  • Duncan Crabtree-Ireland - SAG-AFTRA National Executive Director and Chief Negotiator and leading LGBTQ rights advocate

  • and a special virtual appearance by Hon. Sarah McBride - Trans trailblazer, Delaware State Senator, and current Congressional Candidate

The night will be full of friends, LGBTQ luminaries, and more! We are also excited to feature Whoopi Goldberg’s “Whoopi Prosecco” - because Pride is about celebration! Join us! We would love to see you there! 

Thank You to Our Generous Sponsors for Supporting our 2024 Annual Event  & SDNYC programming all year long.
